items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s a machine that only Mr. Scully touched. There was no maintenance; he would comedown from Bridgeport and do what ever he had to do. He also built me a... Scully, yeah he’s the one, the only person I let touch the lathe.
